standard_references.evidence: The fetched SDMX Glossary evidence supports reuse of SDMX cross-domain concepts and states that Observation Status has Concept ID OBS_STATUS and Codelist ID CL_OBS_STATUS. The excerpt also includes references to education level, frequency of observation, indicator, measure, and metadata concepts, but does not provide complete code-level mappings for all concepts used in this report.

The fetched registry evidence confirms that the SDMX Global Registry provides a Codelists catalogue/search/detail/export interface. The supplied excerpt does not confirm exact codelist versions or code contents for CL_FREQ, CL_SEX, CL_OBS_STATUS, or unit codelists.

The shared reference catalogue identifies UNESCO ISCED as the authoritative education-level classification to check. No fetched ISCED code table or version evidence was supplied, and the report explicitly says education-level labels require ISCED mapping review.

The principles identify SDMX reference metadata guidance as the source to check for reusable metadata concepts. No fetched excerpt confirms exact concept IDs for the report's methodology, source description, definitions, caveats, revision policy, confidentiality note, or publication date.
The fetched UN M49 excerpt lists country and area code entries. The report does not state a reference area, so UN M49 is not used in the field set or source mappings.

limitations: This codebook preserves two statistical structures from the accepted DSD / Key Family artefact: KF_EDU_ENROLLMENT and KF_EDU_LOWER_SECONDARY_COMPLETION. It does not add INDICATOR as a DSD dimension because the accepted DSDs have fixed statistical scopes.

SDMX_KEY_FAMILY is a non-observation routing/control field used by templates to select one of the accepted DSD / Key Family structures. It is not an SDMX observation component, not a formal data attribute, and not governed by a codelist in this mapping. Its allowed values are accepted DSD identifiers governed by the DSD / Key Family artefact, not codelist codes.

Report-level reference metadata concepts from page 1 are not included in fields because this schema only permits DIMENSION, TIME, MEASURE, and ATTRIBUTE roles, and labeling those concepts as ATTRIBUTE would be misleading. They are retained in source_value_mappings as mappings to MSD/reference metadata concepts rather than DSD observation components.

Codelist identifiers are made operationally consistent with the accepted codelist artefact. Where the accepted DSD used draft IDs, these aliases are treated as the same governed local holding lists for this template: CL_EDUCATION_LEVEL_LOCAL = CL_EDUCATION_LEVEL_REPORT_LOCAL; CL_WEALTH_QUINTILE_SURVEY_LOCAL = CL_WEALTH_QUINTILE_REPORT_LOCAL; CL_EDU_UNIT_MEASURE_LOCAL = CL_UNIT_MEASURE_EDU_REPORT_LOCAL; CL_EDU_OBS_STATUS_LOCAL = CL_OBS_STATUS_EDU_REPORT_LOCAL.

Local holding-code mappings to governed local codelists are approved for automatic local staging only when the printed source value exactly matches the mapped label. This approval does not authorise replacement with external standard codes such as ISCED, SDMX CL_SEX, SDMX CL_FREQ, authoritative unit lists, or SDMX CL_OBS_STATUS.

FREQ is present because the accepted DSDs include it, but the report only prints a Year column. Operational rule: do not auto-generate complete SDMX observation rows until a human confirms the mandatory frequency value and the authoritative CL_FREQ code/version; leave FREQ blank or flagged unresolved in staging templates.
The report does not state a reference area or country; REF_AREA is not included and no geographic source mapping is made.
Education-level values are retained as local report codes pending ISCED review because the report explicitly requires ISCED mapping review and no confirmed ISCED version or code mapping was supplied.
Sex values are mapped to local holding codes only; the supplied external evidence does not confirm exact SDMX CL_SEX code identifiers, version, or the scope of Total.

Wealth quintiles are survey-specific and are not mapped to a standard income or wealth classification. The completion table includes only Lowest, Middle, and Highest quintile; second and fourth quintiles are not invented.
Unit values Students and Percent are mapped to local unit codes because no authoritative unit-measure codelist or code mapping was confirmed from supplied evidence.
Observation status values are mapped to local holding codes; exact mappings to SDMX CL_OBS_STATUS or to a separate modelling-method attribute were not confirmed.

EDUCATION_LEVEL is mandatory for enrollment observations and not applicable for lower-secondary completion observations; WEALTH_QUINTILE is mandatory for lower-secondary completion observations and not applicable for enrollment observations.
The report is synthetic and does not provide detailed construction rules for wealth quintiles, sex Total, model estimates, or duplicate-removal procedures.

Exact standard metadata concept IDs and versions for Methodology, Source description, Statistical definitions, Caveats and limitations, Revision policy, Confidentiality note, and Publication date are not confirmed from supplied external evidence.

fields.name: SDMX Key Family / template structure routing
fields.definition: Non-observation routing field used by the fillable template to select the accepted statistical structure for a row or block of rows. It is derived from the report table title and is not an SDMX observation component or codelist-coded field.
fields.representation: Non-coded routing/control field, not a DSD data attribute. Allowed values are DSD / Key Family identifiers governed by the accepted DSD artefact: KF_EDU_ENROLLMENT, KF_EDU_LOWER_SECONDARY_COMPLETION. Missing rule: mandatory for template routing before SDMX generation.

fields.name: Frequency of observation
fields.definition: Frequency with which the observation time period is expressed. In the accepted DSDs this is a mandatory key dimension, but in the report it is only derivable from the Year column and must not be automatically coded until the SDMX CL_FREQ annual code and version are confirmed.
fields.representation: Coded dimension. codelist_agency=SDMX candidate; codelist_id=CL_FREQ; codelist_version=not confirmed; attachment_level=key/series; allowed_values=not confirmed; missing_rule=mandatory but unresolved in staging; leave blank or mark unresolved and require human review before complete SDMX row generation.
fields.example: not confirmed; annual candidate derived from Year

fields.name: Education level
fields.definition: Education cycle or level to which an enrollment observation refers. Required for KF_EDU_ENROLLMENT rows and not applicable for KF_EDU_LOWER_SECONDARY_COMPLETION rows. Report labels require ISCED mapping review before production use.
fields.representation: Local coded value pending UNESCO ISCED mapping review. codelist_agency=SYNTH_MIN_LEARNING; codelist_id=CL_EDUCATION_LEVEL_REPORT_LOCAL; codelist_version=2025-report; attachment_level=key/series; allowed_values=PRIMARY, LOWER_SECONDARY, UPPER_SECONDARY; staging_rule=approved for automatic local staging only on exact printed label match; missing_rule=not applicable outside enrollment structure. fields.name: Wealth quintile
fields.definition: Survey-specific wealth quintile used to disaggregate lower-secondary completion-rate estimates. Required for KF_EDU_LOWER_SECONDARY_COMPLETION rows and not applicable for KF_EDU_ENROLLMENT rows.
fields.representation: Local coded survey-specific quintile list. codelist_agency=SYNTH_MIN_LEARNING; codelist_id=CL_WEALTH_QUINTILE_REPORT_LOCAL; codelist_version=2025-report; attachment_level=key/series; allowed_values=LOWEST_QUINTILE, MIDDLE_QUINTILE, HIGHEST_QUINTILE; staging_rule=approved for automatic local staging only on exact printed label match; missing_rule=not applicable outside completion structure. Alias for accepted DSD draft codelist ID CL_WEALTH_QUINTILE_SURVEY_LOCAL.

fields.name: Sex
fields.definition: Sex category used to disaggregate education observations, including Female and Male. Total appears in enrollment rows as an aggregate whose exact inclusion scope is not further defined.
fields.representation: Local coded holding list pending verification against SDMX CL_SEX. codelist_agency=SYNTH_MIN_LEARNING; codelist_id=CL_SEX_REPORT_LOCAL; codelist_version=2025-report; attachment_level=key/series; allowed_values=FEMALE, MALE, TOTAL where applicable; staging_rule=approved for automatic local staging only on exact printed label match; missing_rule=mandatory for both structures; TOTAL allowed for enrollment rows only unless later evidence expands scope.
fields.source_standard: SDMX CL_SEX candidate; governed local holding list used here

fields.name: Time period
fields.definition: Calendar year to which the observation refers.
fields.representation: Gregorian year. codelist_agency=not applicable; codelist_id=not applicable; codelist_version=not applicable; attachment_level=observation time; allowed_values observed in report=2024, 2025 for enrollment and 2024 for lower-secondary completion; staging_rule=approved for automatic staging from exact Year value; missing_rule=mandatory for both structures.

fields.name: Observation value
fields.definition: Numeric value of the measured education statistic. For enrollment this is a headcount of students; for completion this is a percentage value. Interpretation is determined by the selected Key Family and UNIT_MEASURE.
fields.representation: Numeric decimal. codelist_agency=not applicable; codelist_id=not applicable; codelist_version=not applicable; attachment_level=observation; allowed_values=valid numeric values printed in the table; staging_rule=approved for automatic staging from exact numeric table cells; missing_rule=mandatory; do not include formatted percent signs in this field.

fields.name: Unit of measure
fields.definition: Unit in which the observation value is expressed, as printed in the report. For KF_EDU_ENROLLMENT the constant reported unit is Students. For KF_EDU_LOWER_SECONDARY_COMPLETION the constant reported unit is Percent.
fields.representation: Local coded unit list pending authoritative unit codelist review. codelist_agency=SYNTH_MIN_LEARNING; codelist_id=CL_UNIT_MEASURE_EDU_REPORT_LOCAL; codelist_version=2025-report; attachment_level=dataset for each accepted structure; allowed_values=STUDENTS, PERCENT; staging_rule=approved for automatic local staging only on exact printed label match; missing_rule=mandatory for both structures. Alias for accepted DSD draft codelist ID CL_EDU_UNIT_MEASURE_LOCAL.
fields.source_standard: LOCAL governed holding list; authoritative SDMX/domain unit codelist not confirmed

fields.name: Observation status
fields.definition: Status, finality, or estimation qualifier associated with the observation value, as printed in the report. Final and Provisional occur in enrollment rows; Modelled estimate occurs in completion-rate rows.
fields.representation: Local coded holding list pending verification against SDMX CL_OBS_STATUS or other appropriate quality/status representation. codelist_agency=SYNTH_MIN_LEARNING; codelist_id=CL_OBS_STATUS_EDU_REPORT_LOCAL; codelist_version=2025-report; attachment_level=observation for enrollment and dataset for completion in the accepted DSDs; allowed_values=FINAL, PROVISIONAL, MODELLED_ESTIMATE; staging_rule=approved for automatic local staging only on exact printed label match; missing_rule=mandatory where status is printed. Alias for accepted DSD draft codelist ID CL_EDU_OBS_STATUS_LOCAL.
